Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 11
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer drew a premature and incorrect conclusion from the Met page by (a) misinterpreting the note “hands in long, loose sleeves” for the snake as implying visible hands, and (b) assuming the absence of explicit mentions for other animals meant no visible hands. It failed to review the images/descriptions of all twelve figures and conflated a general collection page with the 2015 exhibition context. This unsupported inference (“only the snake”) propagated to the final answer, leading to the incorrect result.
